notes.title: Steam Next Fest Preparations Coming Soon: October 2024
notes.content:
With great joy and after much hard work, we announce the new mechanics and features that will be available on the Óga map, which will be Ayo's refuge house, created as a sanctuary for the player to rest, collect new resources, create exclusive foods, and unique handcrafted items.

[b]FISHING[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/9d6737e56fe5eade47dd188ffb51f5940e78d0ad.gif[/img]

Now our character can fish! Fishing will be available only on the Óga map for now, but the player will be able to enjoy catching several types of fish, among other items available when reeling in the line. Besides relaxing and enjoying a nice fishing session.

[b]CHICKENS[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/0e2b05c8cf49448b3cc3ee900a1663b0d17f4e73.png[/img]

Get some seeds and feed the chickens! Feed them three times and receive an egg as a reward. In addition to recovering HP when eaten, the egg will also serve as a resource for creating unique dishes.

[b]TREEHOUSE[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/437e7dad6109a3c677cde8315b8673ef83c3effa.gif[/img]

Additional mechanics included inside the house:
[list]
[*] A chest with extra space for storage;
[*] A workbench for making food and drinks;
[*] A crafting bench to create personalized items;
[*] A hammock to rest and recover health points.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/6ba1c59214a67c23528db6215f84af139c0de0cb.gif[/img]

[b]MORE UPDATES:[/b]
Improved water animations, new peaceful animals added to the map, more quests, two new songs, and sound effects included, along with new items for collection across various maps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/f38fd1494d887971c27c6bc5dfaafb52a35f4ae3.png[/img]

[b]SHAMANIC CROSSING SCROLL[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/60249aaa45a4d9974fdb08fda1d9474f63378fba.png[/img]

A new and important feature has been added to the game: the Teleport Scroll!
Ayo can now teleport to places marked with the shamanic stone. By using the scroll, he can travel to the points indicated in its description. This is a valuable item for game progression, moving Ayo to important locations on the map, making it easier to complete quests or simply to collect exclusive resources from a specific region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/a65948557b8891e3cbed0111116c927ecf5e9336.gif[/img]

We thank everyone for supporting indie developers! We currently work as a two-member team: Santhiago and Luis Santos. We are a small team, but with a big dream of making this game beloved by everyone!

We are always open to feedback, comments, and suggestions. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!
See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Big News Coming Soon: Support The South Island!
Devlog - July 2024
notes.content:
Welcome everyone!
We continue with updates and good news about the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/deaa63196afff13e8f58b6a0f8a4464ea5f8cdef.png[/img]

- 3 new maps added: Magic Forest, Dangerous Canyon, and Pampeana Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/dc6730b89fe8dd533c842dc6bbdbd5c62b067941.png[/img]

- New item added to the game: "Moon Potion". When used, it activates an ability that protects the player from damage for 10 seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/ca47a8da34d26143d7efd0eaf5f1a6683d9c8f81.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/e473409e5926ec65888c3d66a18a7017edb7c77a.png[/img]

- Two variations of the new Pirate enemy, which dominate the entire Canyon area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/21486104eedb8903472cdc76849d766a8b17fbd2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/e961eb3b89e759c32aa6cec7c642a0eed474bf48.gif[/img]

- New BOSS Charrua in progress, the leader of the Pampeana tribe and ally of the pirates. Charrua challenges our character Ayo to combat, which will be in 2D platform mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/ee2e769ad697a8ad002219d3be15a71396270b30.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/7fc21da278e1ba3051b6ab768cebcb675e32e962.png[/img]

We thank everyone for supporting indie developers!

We are always open to feedback, comments, and suggestions. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

See you in the next devlog!

notes.title: Devlog - June 2024
notes.content:
Welcome to our first devlog on Steam. 
We will share here the latest updates and news we've been working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/f16c6a7a4519fda02346ef26d819e8f1774112b7.gif[/img]

- 11 completed maps in the game: Enchanted Beach (Boss Fight with Iara in 2D platform style), Coastal Forest, Dangerous Swamp, Guarani Village (West), Open Fields, Bridge Entrance (Boss Fight with Boitatá), Cave, Araucaria Forest, Gês Village (East), Abandoned Hills, and Spirit Waterfall. Including all environmental resources of fauna and flora.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/bc2d96f7e5c5e991ec5d454df7b80c84e10de60f.png[/img]

- We created 10 new enemies, each with unique characteristics and targeted to their natural habitat.

- Two Puzzles completed. In the Cave, discover where and how to push the stones to the button to open the big rock door. In the Araucaria Forest, deactivate an illegal tree-cutting sawmill, and figure out which lever and the correct order to shut down the cutting machine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/de58a436ed2728402d56c3163c64c1feea14bdb5.png[/img]
- We added some weapons: hatchet, spear, bow and arrow, each with 4 levels of strength: common, rare, epic, and legendary. Some weapons will be available for purchase in village shops, and others will be received after completing a mission.

- Currently, we have 30 missions created in the game. Missions will be visible in the game menu when accessing the mini-map. Upon completing a mission, the player will receive an XP reward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/7d8426c3184717d6bd592f6499a3e1b28df403f2.gif[/img]

- After much effort and determination, we finished the player's attribute points system. By filling the XP bar by defeating enemies and completing missions, the player will receive 1 attribute point, which can be used to upgrade the character's health, strength, speed, and defense. These points can be redistributed and upgraded according to the skill strategy chosen by the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/8aca78b3d1a62f1ca7833ee91142fb20e7f3c899.png[/img]

- Some special masks have been added to the game. By carrying a mask in the inventory, the player receives the additional ability of that mask.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/4b7329340033063929af3621f8e9fe1c9e395981.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029454/231f1d4a1f3c090d148599d344d8bee3096e5b85.png[/img]

We thank everyone for supporting indie developers! Currently, we work in a two-member team: Santhiago and Luis Santos. We are a small team with a big dream to make this game lovable for everyone!

We are always open to feedback, comments, and suggestions. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!
See you in the next devlog!
